issue.title: [test gap] Validate dynamic threshold buffer config changes initiated through the generic config updater (GCU)

failure.body:
**Description**
When the dynamic threshold value is changed on a switch through an `apply-patch` on the generic config updater (GCU), there may be failures caused by a faulty config on the device or a fault with the patch file, or some other failure of the GCU. Currently, there is no way of validating such failures through tests on the nightly.

resolution.title: [GCU] Changing dynamic threshold test for GCU
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary: This test assesses the scenario for when the dynamic_th value needs to be adjusted for ingress/egress profiles. Specifically, this test checks for GCU dynamic threshold value changes to pg_lossless buffer profiles found on a switch.

Fixes #7986

### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [x] Test case(new/improvement)

- [ ] 201911
- [ ] 202012
- [x] 202205

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
GCU test gap for dynamic threshold value changes

#### How did you do it?
Created a json patch for dynamic threshold value changes using GCU, and wrote a script that applies that change, tests for whether the config change was successful, and reverts back the config to the original checkpoint before the test.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Tested on lab device.
